knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A measured response time can be checked from records. The other options cannot be checked.
The milestone should follow the evidence, with the earlier date flagged as an assumption rather than kept as a fixed promise.
The milestone plan is a private tool and does not need the financial detail a lender expects. Lenders do accept written plans, and the length of a formal plan is not the point.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes three dated milestones, each containing at least one measure that can be checked from records.
Learner answers all seven planning questions in writing and marks each assumption.
Learner records a quarterly review date and explains one adjustment to a milestone with its reason.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written answers to the seven planning questions
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Mark any answer that depends on evidence you do not yet have as an assumption, and adjust it.
